messages:
Asha (finance): Quick one — customer ACCT-12345 on Private/VPC. Their June invoice shows our committed GPU reservation cost on our bill, but they expected pass-through of cloud charges. Can we split the committed discount vs on-demand so we bill them correctly?

Luca (infra): We placed them in the shared private pool in eu-west1. That pool is covered by our 3x A100 monthly reservation. We didn't carve a customer-specific reservation. We thought shared pooling was fine for utilization.

Priya (eng-sre): Operational note: tags are the only way to retroactively attribute reservations to a tenant. We don't currently tag at the VM/GPU SKU level for private pools — it's pooled. Retro-tagging is possible from allocation logs but noisy.

Marco (sales): Contract language says "pass-through cloud charges" w/o detail. Sales needs a clean billing split to avoid disputes. Customer is pressing for line-item detail.

Asha (finance): Options I'm thinking: 1) amortize reservation cost across tenants by gpu-hour usage 2) charge customer on-demand and absorb reservation benefit 3) reassign reservation(s) to customer moving forward and change pricing. Thoughts?

Nina (acct mgr): Finance preference is amortize across actual GPU-hours. Simple and defensible. Formula: share = (tenant_gpu_hours / total_gpu_hours) * reserved_cost. Add tenant's on-demand hours * on_demand_rate for non-reserved usage.

Luca (infra): Amortization is fine but watch region SKUs — reserved A100 in eu-west1 priced differently than us-west1. Also if tenant used 0 hours, they'd still get charged a share — that's awkward.

Priya (eng-sre): Agree. Operationally, if we want per-tenant clarity long-term we should: a) tag private pools per-customer, or b) create dedicated tenant pools (dedicated capacity). Tagging automation + billing pipeline changes needed. ETA ~3 weeks for infra work.

Nina (acct mgr): Quick formula for finance automation (example):
```
reserved_share = (tenant_gpu_hours / total_gpu_hours) * reserved_monthly_cost
pass_through_charge = reserved_share + (tenant_on_demand_hours * on_demand_rate)
```

ops-bot: billing-bot: Detected invoice vs expected pass-through mismatch for ACCT-12345. Created ticket BILL-789 and attached current invoice snapshot: https://redwood.internal/billing/BILL-789

Maya (legal): Contract ambiguity risk here. "Cloud charges" could mean on-demand or committed. Recommend a one-line amendment: "Cloud pass-through charges will be billed on an amortized committed-reservation basis where reservations are pooled." Also offer a credit path for prior month if we change approach.

Asha (finance): Good. Can we run the amortized numbers for May/June so we see customer impact? If impact >10% we should consider a one-off credit. Nina, can you run and post numbers by EOD?

Nina (acct mgr): Will do. Quick sample calc (placeholder): tenant_hours=1200, total_hours=6400, reserved_cost=€36,000/month -> reserved_share = (1200/6400)*36000 = €6,750. If on_demand_rate * tenant_on_demand_hours = €2,300 -> pass_through_charge = €9,050. Current billed (on-demand-only) was €10,980 -> proposed credit ≈ €1,930. I'll upload the CSV and pivot by region.

Marco (sales): Customer wants fast fix. Can we give provisional credit on June invoice while infra/legal implements long-term fix?

Luca (infra): We're ok with provisional credit but mark it manual. For long term: tagging + billing pipeline changes so invoices show per-tenant reserved amortization line. That requires infra + billing eng changes.

Asha (finance): Finance okay with ad-hoc credit under €5k. If Nina's numbers <€5k we can approve immediate credit and then implement long-term technical fix and contract amendment.

Priya (eng-sre): Noted. I'll open infra ticket to scope tagging + dedicated pool option.

Nina (acct mgr): Uploaded numbers: https://redwood.internal/billing/analysis/ACCT-12345-may.csv — will DM Asha & Marco with detailed pivot.

Maya (legal): I'll draft the amendment language and loop in GC. Suggest timeline: draft today, customer sign within 7 days.

Asha (finance): Next steps summary: 1) Nina posts final amortized calc by EOD 2) If credit <= €5k finance approves provisional credit 3) Legal drafts amendment 4) Infra scopes tagging/dedicated-pool ETA ~3w. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

Marco (sales): Thanks — keeping customer in the loop now.

ops-bot: billing-bot: Ticket BILL-789 updated with "provisional credit pending finance approval"

(threads end)
